key_insight: AffordCraft turns a single RGB image into a task-ready articulated simulation asset by retrieving and fitting a matching object from a library, preserving parts, joints, and physical validity.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a scalable way to bootstrap robot manipulation assets and tasks from ordinary photos without manual masks or repeated generative reconstruction.
method: Detect the target object and the operable part from the image and task instruction.
Retrieve a matching articulated asset from a curated library instead of synthesizing geometry from scratch.
Fit the retrieved model to the image while keeping its articulation and contact-ready physical structure intact.
evidence_signal: The system produced physically valid assets for 1,703 of 2,000 images across 31 categories, and on 50 cluttered images it passed 162 of 237 annotated objects after automatic detection.
watch_item: Performance depends on the coverage and label quality of the asset library, so rare categories or ambiguous part labels may still limit retrieval success.
paper_title: AffordCraft: Scalable Construction of Task-Ready Simulation Assets from Single Images
